name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Primary top navigation bar (role=banner) with a centred desktop nav and a full-viewport off-canvas mobile menu below --hbd-navbar-mobile-breakpoint (768px). The hamburger toggle carries aria-expanded/aria-controls; the mobile menu is a role=dialog aria-modal panel portalled to document.body and behaves exactly like <hbd-drawer>: ref-counted scroll-lock, focus-trap (Tab/Shift+Tab cycling), return-focus, Escape-to-close, and auto-close when a debounced resize crosses back above the breakpoint (token read off the host). Links auto-mark .is-active + aria-current=page on pathname match. Compound API: Navbar + Navbar.Logo / Navbar.Link / Navbar.Actions, mirrored into both the desktop row and the mobile menu. Variants: sticky / transparent / bordered. Controlled-first open + onOpenChange with defaultOpen fallback, plus onOpen/onClose (the WC's hbd:open / hbd:close).
